title: vicia coquimbensis
intro: Vicia coquimbensis, commonly known as Coquimbo vetch, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Vicia coquimbensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
